summary: Tested scraper-provider delete backend + frontend scope. Unit delete behavior passed; public API/UI auth-gated checks were blocked by preview endpoint timeouts during active background scraper traffic.

critical.issue: Public DELETE/login verification timed out (ReadTimeout / curl timeout) before receiving expected 401/404 assertions.

integration_issues.flow: Admin login -> Store Management -> Integrations -> Scraper provider delete dialog
integration_issues.issue: Login stayed at 'Signing in…'; dashboard shell did not load, so runtime click validation for trash-dialog/cancel could not be executed in browser.

action_items: Stabilize preview ingress/API responsiveness for /api/admin-accounts/login and /api/scraper/apis/* so auth-gated delete e2e can run.
Re-run authenticated browser flow to validate live click behavior: all provider trash buttons rendered, ScrapingBee dialog shows cancel+permanent delete, and cancel triggers zero DELETE calls.

MOCKED policy breach in environment state: backend logs show live third-party scraper calls (ScrapingBee/ScraperAPI/eBay URLs) running during this iteration; isolate/disable background scraper jobs for deterministic testing.
No code functional fix applied; only test coverage files were added/updated.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains a large monolith (>700 lines), raising regression risk for tightly-coupled scraper/auth/settings changes.

Delete endpoint implementation is correctly session-protected and removes provider rows from settings + scraper_provider_usage by code review, but live contract verification is still blocked by runtime timeout instability.

success_rate.backend: 50% (2/4 in focused suite passed; 2/4 blocked by timeout)
success_rate.frontend: 35% (login screen load passed; auth-gated delete flow blocked before navigation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Unit tests now include no-reseed and no-mutation assertions for delete behavior. API/browser checks against public URL hit repeated login/delete timeouts while backend background scraper traffic was active; avoid running when scheduler/provider calls are in-flight.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: (1) Run pytest test_scraper_provider_delete_api.py or curl POST /api/admin-accounts/login against public URL; (2) requests time out at 20-30s with no response; (3) Playwright login remains stuck at Signing in. Evidence: pytest ReadTimeout stack traces + browser request failures + backend logs showing continuous outbound scraper provider requests during the same window. Mitigation: pause/disable background scraper schedule in preview, then rerun focused auth/delete checks.
